title: [Snappi]: Incorrect behavior in port-selection infra if similar ports from different LCs or DUTs are used in the test.
author: amitpawar12
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

If similar interfaces from two different LCs are selected for the test, then most of the port-selection function fail because there is no check on hostname.

Example:
If user has Ethernet144 on LC1 and Ethernet144 on LC2, then most of the infra-code fails.

Code:
snappi_fixtures.py has function setup_dut_ports which has following sub-functions to select ports from snappi_ports:
- __vlan_intf_config
- __portchannel_intf_config
- __intf_config_multidut
- __l3_intf_config

Each of these functions, then go through the snappi_ports to select the port for the test. However, it ONLY check if the port-name matches and does not check if the port belongs to the right duthost.

Example:
for '__portchannel_intf_config':
```
member_port_ids = [i for i, sp in enumerate(snappi_ports) for m in members if sp['peer_port'] == m]
```

for '__l3_intf_config':
```
port_ids = [i for i, sp in enumerate(snappi_ports) if sp['peer_port'] == intf]
```
The above will fail if the same interface names from two different duthosts are used. 

There should be a check to ensure that interfaces from right duthost are selected.

### Steps to Reproduce

Select two similar port-names from two different duthosts. Example Ethernet144 on LC1 and LC2 for test.

Ensure that either '__l3_intf_config' or '__portchannel_intf_config' is used for port selection.

Check the port_config_list in function 'setup_dut_ports' function once the ports are selected. The port_config_list will select the same port from same DUT as Tx and Rx.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The test ends up selecting same port from same DUT as Tx and Rx port. 

There should be check for duthost hostname when the port from snappi_port is selected.

Snappi has infra file snappi_fixtures.py and function setup_dut_ports to populate port_config_list for selecting right Rx and Tx ports for the test.

It iterates through the VLAN interfaces, Portchannels, L3 interfaces in that order to select the ports. However, in port-channel and l3_interfaces, it goes through the snappi_ports only based on the names (say Ethernet144) to select the ports.

This is an issue if test has two or more LCs with same port names in the test. Example - LC1 has Ethernet144 and so does LC2.

In this case, a code like this, will cause same port to be selected:
member_port_ids = [i for i, sp in enumerate(snappi_ports) for m in members if sp['peer_port'] == m]

The snappi_ports will have LC1-Ethernet144 and LC2-Ethernet144, causing member_port_ids to match ONLY the first port-name Ethernet144 of LC1 everytime.

This PR addresses the issue by checking dut-hostname as well, thus ensuring that same port does not get selected twice.

Fixes are present in function - __portchannel_intf_config and __l3_intf_config.

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
The selection of same port on two different LCs will cause same snappi_port to be selected every time as Rx and Tx.

#### How did you do it?
Included duthost.hostname + peer_port to be used as key instead of just peer_port.

In this case, the right port from different DUT will be selected, even though port-names are same.
